findings.source: e-Sbírka — official Czech electronic Collection of Laws (e-sbirka.gov.cz, formerly www.e-sbirka.cz; info portal zakony.gov.cz; open-data host opendata.eselpoint.gov.cz, formerly opendata.eselpoint.cz)

access.auth: api-key — header name `esel-api-access-key` (verbatim from the official OpenAPI file and from working client code that shipped a real 65-char key). Registration: fill the PDF form 'Žádost o registraci klienta veřejného REST API e-Sbírky' (https://opendata.eselpoint.cz/dokumentace/Zadost%20o%20registraci%20klienta.pdf) and send it via datová schránka to the Ministry of Interior box 6bnaawp with subject 'e-Sbírka – registrace REST API' (per the 2024 announcement; e-Sbírka administration has since been moving to DIA — verify the current recipient on https://e-sbirka.gov.cz/restful-api or /open-data). Free; you state purpose and expected query volume.
access.detail:
OFFICIAL REGISTERED PUBLIC REST API ('Veřejné API e-Sbírky'). The official OpenAPI 3.0 definition is published as https://opendata.eselpoint.cz/dokumentace/Definicni_soubor_REST_API_e-Sbirka.zip and a copy is committed verbatim in github.com/kokes/esbirka/openapi.json (title: 'Definiční soubor Veřejného API e-Sbírky', servers[0].url='/esel-esbir-daver', security: ApiKey in header `esel-api-access-key`). Working 2024 client code (hustyladislav/laws_rag, hustyladislav/speechtexttomedical) calls it at https://api.e-sbirka.cz/... with that header; 2026-era repos reference https://api.e-sbirka.gov.cz as the base after the gov.cz domain migration (unconfirmed in working code). 66 endpoints; the key ones:

IDENTIFIER: everything is addressed by `staleUrl` = '/{sbirka}/{rok}/{cislo}' optionally + '/{YYYY-MM-DD}' for a time version, e.g. '/sb/2012/89', '/sb/1993/1/2026-01-01', '/sb/2000/121/0000-00-00' (0000-00-00 = as-announced/vyhlášené znění; no date = current version). Collections: sb (Sbírka zákonů), sm/ul0/ul1 etc. When used as a path parameter the staleUrl MUST be percent-encoded whole (quote(x, safe='') → '%2Fsb%2F1993%2F1%2F2026-01-01'). Fragment anchors: '#12-4-f_3', '#cast_10/hlava_2/dil_1/oddil_11/pododdil_22', '#f123456789' (examples verbatim from the spec).

(a) FULL-TEXT SEARCH: POST /jednoducha-vyhledavani — JSON body {"fulltext":"...","start":0,"pocet":25,"razeni":["+relevance"]} (schema DokumentySbirkyJednoduchyFiltr = StrankovaniARazeni {start,pocet,razeni[]} + {fulltext, czechVocPreferovanyTerminTextNazvu}); response {pocetCelkem, seznam:[{staleUrl,nazev,kodDokumentuSbirky,stavDokumentuSbirky,datum}], fazetovyFiltr}. POST /rozsirena-vyhledavani (advanced) body: {fulltextVsechnaSlova, fulltextUvedenaFraze, fulltextJednoZeSlov, fulltextNeobsahujeSlova, rozsahVyhledavani:[enum VSECHNA_ZNENI|AKTUALNI_ZNENI|NOVELY|VYHLASENE_ZNENI|BEZ_NOVEL|PLATNE|POUZE_CR|POUZE_UCINNE], kodyTypAktu[], kodyPodtypAktu[], predmetneDatumOd/Do (date), dalsiPodminky[]} + paging. Suggesters: GET /jednoducha-vyhledavani/nabidka, GET /rozsirena-vyhledavani/nabidka-nazvu-dokumentu-sbirky, /nabidka-kodu-dokumentu-sbirky.

(b) CONSOLIDATED TEXT AS OF A DATE: GET /dokumenty-sbirky/{encodedStaleUrl} → DokumentSbirkyDetail metadata (nazev, staleUrl, eli, dokumentBaseid, datumCasVyhlaseni, datumUcinnostiOd, datumUcinnostiZneniOd/Do, typZneni, uplnaCitace, novely[], ...). Then GET /dokumenty-sbirky/{encodedStaleUrl}/fragmenty?cisloStranky=0 → {seznam:[Fragment], pocetStranek} — fixed-size pages, iterate cisloStranky 0..pocetStranek-1. Fragment fields: id, eli, staleUrl (with #anchor into the concrete version), kodTypuFragmentu (e.g. 'Paragraf', 'Odstavec_Dc'), xhtml (the text as HTML), uplnaCitace, zkracenaCitace (e.g. '§ 7 odst. 5 zákona č. 31/1993 Sb.'), hloubka (nesting depth), jeUcinny, maNovelizace, maDerogace. Put the date in the staleUrl ('/sb/1993/1/2026-01-01') to get that time version's text. Fulltext-in-act params on the same endpoint: fulltextJednoZeSlov, fulltextVsechnaSlova, fulltextUvedenaFraze.

(c) SINGLE SECTION (§): there is NO endpoint returning one fragment's text by id; the granular path is GET /dokumenty-sbirky/{encodedStaleUrl}/nabidka-ustanoveni?text=§ 12&maxPocet=10 → provisions matching the label incl. fragmentId, then either filter the /fragmenty pages by zkracenaCitace/anchor, or (cleaner) use the SPARQL/JSON-LD channel where each § is an addressable IRI (see the opendata entry). Per-fragment info endpoints exist: GET /dokumenty-sbirky/{staleUrl}/fragmenty/{fragmentId}/novelizace-a-derogace, /ostatni-kontextove-informace, /vykladova-stanoviska, /konsolidacni-konflikty, /upozorneni.

(d) TIME VERSIONS: GET /dokumenty-sbirky/{encodedStaleUrl}/historie → {historie:[ZaznamHistorie]} (each = DokumentSbirkyZneni + cisloZneni + poznamky[]; includes účinnost dates and amendment info). Alternative: POST /jednoducha-vyhledavani/zneni body {"dokumentSbirkyStaleUrl":"/sb/2012/89"} → all znění + related documents. Also GET /dokumenty-sbirky/zmeny-zneni and /dokumenty-sbirky/depublikovana-zneni for change feeds.

OTHER: POST /chronologicke-rejstriky/dokumenty-sbirky-po-mesicich {"rok":2020} → per-month listing {dokumentySbirkyVMesici:[{mesic, sbirkyDokumentuSbirky:[{sadaDokumentuKod, dokumentySbirkyRejstrikInfo:[{staleUrl,datum,nazev,kodDokumentuSbirky,stavDokumentuSbirky}]}]}]}; GET /castky/{kodSbirky}/{rok}/{cislo} (issue metadata incl. overeneZneniOdkazPdf.dokumentId); downloads: GET /stahni/overene-zneni/{dokumentId}, /stahni/pravne-zavazne-zneni/{dokumentId}/{formatSouboru}; GET /sbirky, /typy-aktu, /typy-fragmentu (code lists); CzechVoc thesaurus endpoints (/czechvoc-*).

access.base_url: https://e-sbirka.gov.cz/sbr-externi and https://e-sbirka.gov.cz/sbr-cache (old domain www.e-sbirka.cz still serves the same paths)
access.auth: none — no API key, no cookies; just Accept: application/json (multiple working scrapers 2024–2026)
access.detail:
KEYLESS ALTERNATIVE, best fit for a serverless MCP server doing live per-request queries. The e-Sbírka SPA's own backend exposes the SAME endpoint surface as the registered public API (same paths as in the OpenAPI file) under two gateways: `/sbr-externi` (live) and `/sbr-cache` (Varnish-cached layer, faster; used by the frontend). Verified working in independent client code:
- GET https://e-sbirka.gov.cz/sbr-cache/dokumenty-sbirky/%2Fsb%2F1993%2F1%2F2026-01-01 → metadata incl. `dokumentBaseId` (and error shape {"chyby":[{popis}]}); also plain '/sb/1993/1' for current version (legalize-pipeline, Apollyus/zakony-es-projekt)
- GET .../sbr-cache/dokumenty-sbirky/{enc}/fragmenty?cisloStranky=N and .../sbr-externi/dokumenty-sbirky/{enc}/fragmenty?cisloStranky=N → {seznam:[{id, eli, staleUrl, kodTypuFragmentu, xhtml, zkracenaCitace, uplnaCitace, hloubka,...}], pocetStranek} — versioned staleUrl gives text as of a date (ampapacek/MorphemeOrigin, Zizlik/ai-pravnik, legalize-pipeline)
- POST .../sbr-cache/jednoducha-vyhledavani with {"fulltext":"...","start":0,"pocet":25,"razeni":["+relevance"]} → {pocetCelkem, seznam, fazetovyFiltr} (legalize-pipeline; NOTE its docstring: pagination beyond page 1 returned 400 on start>0 and facet filters were ignored — verify before relying on deep paging)
- POST https://www.e-sbirka.cz/sbr-externi/chronologicke-rejstriky/dokumenty-sbirky-po-mesicich {"rok":2020} → year/month registry (MorphemeOrigin)
- GET https://e-sbirka.gov.cz/sbr-cache/dokumenty-sbirky/{enc}/id → numeric document id (OpenSanctions production crawler)
- Whole consolidated act in ONE file: GET .../sbr-cache/stahni/informativni-zneni/{docId}/JSON → {stavPozadavku:'OK', id:'<uuid>', nazevDokumentu}; then GET https://e-sbirka.gov.cz/souborove-sluzby/soubory/{uuid} → JSON with a flat `fragmenty` list ({typ, xhtml,...}) (OpenSanctions). Same with /DOCX for a Word file of the informativní znění (Apollyus: GET /sbr-externi/stahni/informativni-zneni/{dokumentBaseId}/DOCX). PDF 'ověřené znění': GET /sbr-externi/stahni/overene-zneni/{dokumentId} (PDFs of older acts are scans, not text)
- GET https://www.e-sbirka.cz/sbr-externi/castky/sb/{rok}/{cislo} → issue metadata incl. overeneZneniOdkazPdf.dokumentId (tomaswrobel/tombot)
Portal ELI resolver also exists: https://e-sbirka.gov.cz/eli/cz/sb/{rok}/{cislo} (redirects to the act page).

TWO keyless open-data channels:

1) SPARQL endpoint: GET https://opendata.eselpoint.gov.cz/sparql?query=<urlencoded SELECT> with Accept: application/json → standard SPARQL JSON results. Vocabulary prefix https://slovník.gov.cz/datový/sbírka/pojem/ — predicates verified 2026-04-30 by DIA's own datagov-cz/ismd-tool-backend: právní-akt (class), citace-právního-aktu ('187/2006 Sb.'), číslo-předpisu, rok-předpisu (xsd:gYear), patří-do-sbírky ('sb'/'ul0'/'ul1'/'sm'), má-poslední-znění, má-znění, znění-právního-aktu (class), účinnost-znění-od / účinnost-znění-do (xsd:date), má-typ-znění-právního-aktu, má-fragment-znění, označení-fragmentu-znění-právního-aktu, citace-označení-fragmentu-znění-právního-aktu, má-předka, pořadí-fragmentu-znění-právního-aktu (hex, lex-sortable), obsahuje-fragment, text-fragmentu / obsah (fragment HTML body). Act IRIs: https://opendata.eselpoint.gov.cz/esel-esb/eli/cz/sb/{rok}/{cislo}; version IRIs add /{YYYY-MM-DD}; fragment IRIs add /dokument/norma/cast_1/par_3a/odst_3 (par_/odst_/pism_/bod_/cast_/hlava_/oddil_/dil_ segments) — this is the cleanest way to fetch a SINGLE § and to list time versions without any key. Working query patterns in worldwidelaw/legal-sources sources/CZ/eSbirka/bootstrap.py (list acts, get latest version, get ordered full text via má-fragment-znění → obsahuje-fragment → text-fragmentu, ORDER BY pořadí).

2) ELI JSON-LD dereference: GET https://opendata.eselpoint.gov.cz/esel-esb/eli/cz/sb/{rok}/{cislo} with header Accept: application/ld+json → act JSON-LD incl. 'má-poslední-znění' IRI (used in production by opensanctions/opensanctions cz/terrorists crawler).

3) Bulk dumps (batch, NOT for serverless live use): directory listing at https://opendata.eselpoint.gov.cz/datove-sady-esbirka/ with .json.gz and .jsonld.gz files: 002PravniAkt.json.gz (~5 MB act list; keys akt-citace, akt-sbírka-kód, akt-rok-předpisu, akt-číslo-předpisu, akt-název-vyhlášený), 001PravniAktZneni.json.gz (~176 MB, version metadata incl. znění-datum-účinnosti-od/do, znění-dokument-id), 003PravniAktZneniFragment.json.gz (~1.2 GB fragment tree), 004PravniAktFragment.json.gz (~530 MB fragment texts, cis-esb-typ-fragmentu: Paragraf/Odstavec_Dc/...), 006PravniAktMetadata, 010PravniAktBinarniSoubor, 043PravniAktDigitalniReplika. Format is one giant JSON object with a 'položky' array (up to >25 GB decompressed; kokes/esbirka od.py streams and converts to NDJSON). Docs folder: https://opendata.eselpoint.cz/dokumentace/ (registration PDF + Definicni_soubor_REST_API_e-Sbirka.zip = the OpenAPI file).

findings.caveats: 1) Could not live-probe anything from this environment (egress proxy blocks all Czech domains incl. lupa.cz and opendata.eselpoint.cz), so 'working' means verbatim in client code from repos active 2024–2026, plus the official OpenAPI definition file; the newest first-hand verification dates are 2026-04/05 (DIA's ismd-tool-backend SPARQL comments, OpenSanctions crawler, zakony-es-projekt). 2) Two generations of domains: www.e-sbirka.cz / opendata.eselpoint.cz (2024 launch) vs e-sbirka.gov.cz / opendata.eselpoint.gov.cz (current in 2025/2026); clients show both still serving, prefer the gov.cz forms. Registered-API host seen working as api.e-sbirka.cz (2024 code with a real key); several 2026 repos reference api.e-sbirka.gov.cz but none shows a verified call — treat the exact current host as to-confirm after registration. 3) The keyless /sbr-externi and /sbr-cache backends are the SPA's own services — undocumented, no SLA, could change without notice; one 2026 scraper implements adaptive throttling because 429/5xx occur under load; another notes POST /jednoducha-vyhledavani returned 400 for start>0 and ignored facet filters (deep pagination unreliable — for enumeration use the chronological registry or sequential /sb/{year}/{n} probing). 4) staleUrl path params must be percent-encoded including slashes (%2Fsb%2F...); responses use Czech keys incl. diacritics, and open-data JSON keys contain Czech diacritics ('položky', 'akt-číslo-předpisu') — keep UTF-8 handling strict. 5) /fragmenty is fixed-page (pocetStranek = pages, not fragments; page size constant server-side for Varnish caching); no single-§-by-id REST endpoint — use SPARQL fragment IRIs or filter fragment pages. 6) PDF 'ověřené znění' of older acts are page scans (no text layer); use fragment xhtml, the JSON informativní znění, or DOCX instead. 7) Registered API: registration instructions from Jan 2024 say MV ČR data box 6bnaawp, subject 'e-Sbírka – registrace REST API'; DIA has been taking over e-Sbírka operation, so confirm the current recipient at https://e-sbirka.gov.cz/restful-api (page exists; content not retrievable from here). No published rate limits anywhere; the registration form asks for expected query volume. 8) Fragment 'razeni'/order in dumps and SPARQL is a lex-sortable hex string — sort lexicographically, not numerically. 9) One high-ranking GitHub repo (jirisar7-eng/Pomoc_otcum-) contains invented endpoints ('https://www.e-sbirka.cz/api/v1/vyhledavani?dotaz=', 'esb_live_...' keys) — AI-generated, do not trust; probes confirm www.e-sbirka.cz/api* just 308-redirects.
references: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kokes/esbirka/master/openapi.json (official 'Definiční soubor Veřejného API e-Sbírky', OpenAPI 3.0, 66 paths, esel-api-access-key header)

https://github.com/hustyladislav/laws_rag (real registered-API calls: https://api.e-sbirka.cz/dokumenty-sbirky/... with esel-api-access-key header; also .../souvislosti)

https://github.com/legalize-dev/legalize-pipeline (src/legalize/fetcher/cz/client.py — keyless https://e-sbirka.gov.cz/sbr-cache client: metadata, versioned staleUrl, fragment paging, jednoducha-vyhledavani body; discovery.py — search-pagination 400 caveat, sequential /sb/{year}/{n} probing)

https://github.com/Apollyus/zakony-es-projekt (docs/e-sbirka-api.md — full keyless API reference: sbr-cache/dokumenty-sbirky, sbr-externi/stahni/informativni-zneni/{id}/DOCX, souborove-sluzby/soubory/{uuid}, opendata dataset sizes; stahni-docx.py with 429-adaptive throttling)

findings.source: Nejvyšší správní soud (NSS) decision search — vyhledavac.nssoud.cz (current portal, ASP.NET Core MVC "Vyhledávač NSS", data from ISNSS via internal API into a DXCFTS fulltext engine), plus sbirka.nssoud.cz (official Collection) and the defunct pre-2022 www.nssoud.cz ASPX interface

access.auth: none (but search requires an ASP.NET antiforgery handshake: cookie + __RequestVerificationToken from GET /)
access.detail:
SEARCH (verbatim from the working ingestion adapter apps/api/src/handlers/case-law/ingestion/adapters/cz-nss.ts in github.com/stella/stella). NOT a JSON SPA — it is server-rendered ASP.NET Core MVC; no /api/ JSON endpoints exist anywhere in code that references this host. Flow: (1) GET https://vyhledavac.nssoud.cz/ — collect ALL Set-Cookie pairs, the hidden input __RequestVerificationToken, and every form field (hidden inputs like FormularCiselnik plus empty text inputs of the 'vyhledavaciSekce' model; the ASP.NET model binder rejects the POST unless all fields are echoed back). (2) POST https://vyhledavac.nssoud.cz/Home/Index with Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded, Cookie, Referer: https://vyhledavac.nssoud.cz; body = all harvested fields + __RequestVerificationToken + your criteria. Confirmed criteria field names (2025 form model): 'vyhledavaciSekce[1].vyhledavaciPodminka[0].vyhledavaciPodminkaHodnota[0].HodnotaDatumACasOd' and '...HodnotaDatumACasDo' (decision-date range, format DD.MM.YYYY). Fulltext / spisová značka / soud inputs are further text inputs in the same vyhledavaciSekce[...] hierarchy — exact indices NOT confirmed in any public code; harvest them from the landing-page form at runtime (labels appear next to inputs) rather than hardcoding. GET /Home/Index?formular=4 selects an alternative search form (portal has basic and extended variants for 'rozhodnutí' and 'řízení'); numbering semantics unverified. RESPONSE: HTML. Total: '
Počet nalezených záznamů: N
' (N may be space-grouped, e.g. '1 234'). First 40 result rows are inline. Rows are blocks each containing: hidden input name="ZobrazeneVysledky[N].ID" value="{documentId}"; cells with date (DD.MM.YYYY), case number, court, decision type; links href="/DokumentOriginal/Html/{id}" and href="/DokumentDetail/Index/{id}"; and a citation anchor title="Citace: rozsudek {court} ze dne {date}, čj. {spisová značka}" (Czech chars often HTML-entity-escaped: čj. etc.). The page also embeds pagination state in an inline script: var moreRowsUrl = '/Home/MyResTRowsCont'; var currParams = ''; var currViewId = '1'; var currSort = ''. currParams decodes to the condition JSON, e.g. [{"Id":19,"TechnickyNazev":"datumvydanirozhodnuti","vyhledavaciPodminkaHodnota":[{"HodnotaDatumACasOd":"2026-06-10T00:00:00","HodnotaDatumACasDo":"2026-06-10T00:00:00"}]}]; example currSort: ' order by zvht38.Hodnota NOOR , zvhdt1.Hodnota DESC '. PAGINATION: pages beyond the first via POST https://vyhledavac.nssoud.cz/Home/MyResTRowsCont (AJAX; returns HTML row fragments, same structure) with form body: vyhledavaciPodminky=, zobrazeniVysledkuId=, pageNum=<1-based-beyond-inline: page 1 = rows 41-60>, resultOrder=; headers X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest, Referer: https://vyhledavac.nssoud.cz/Home/Index, Cookie. Page sizes: inline page carries 40 rows; each MyResTRowsCont page carries 20. The endpoint reconstructs the whole search from the POSTed body, not from server session (stella's comment: 'a page can be asked for without the session that first ran the search') — synthesizing vyhledavaciPodminky JSON directly against /Home/MyResTRowsCont is a promising serverless shortcut but is not proven cookie-free/token-free in any public code. An expired session makes POST /Home/Index answer 200 with the blank form re-rendered (no 'Počet nalezených záznamů') — detect by missing count and re-handshake. Data coverage starts 2003-02-04 (portal states zero records before that); portal also lists krajské/městský soud administrative judgments — the deciding court is distinguishable only via the ECLI code on the detail page (NSS, MSPH, KSBR, KSCB, KSHK, KSOS, KSPH, KSPL, KSUL).

access.auth: none — plain GET, no cookies or token needed (proven by stella's backfill-fulltext.ts and dev-reparse.ts which fetch with bare fetch())
access.detail:
DOCUMENT RETRIEVAL by numeric documentId (the id from /DokumentDetail/Index/{id} links or ZobrazeneVysledky[N].ID). Three endpoints, all GET, sessionless: (1) GET /DokumentDetail/Index/{id} — metadata detail page; values sit in
blocks with value; confirmed div ids: 'ecli', 'soudcezpravodaj' (judge-rapporteur), 'soudsenat' (senate), 'oblastupravy' (legal area), 'druhdokumentuavyrokrozhodnuti' (decision type+outcome), 'datumvydanirozhodnuti' (decision date), 'vyrokrozhodnuti' (outcome), 'typrizeni' (case type), 'ucastnicirizeniz' (parties), 'stavrizeni' (case status), 'nazevspravnihoorganu' (administrative authority), 'citace' (Sb. NSS reporter citation); 404 = document has no detail. (2) GET /DokumentOriginal/Html/{id} — full decision text as Aspose.Words-generated HTML (

with inline alignment styles, with font-weight/font-style, paragraph numbers as [N]; sections: ROZSUDEK/USNESENÍ, takto:, Odůvodnění:, Poučení:); an unavailable document returns a tiny page whose body is literally 'N/A' — treat responses <~200 bytes or containing '\n N/A\n' as missing. (3) GET /DokumentOriginal/Text/{id} — plain-text variant, IMPORTANT: body is UTF-16 encoded (decode with TextDecoder('utf-16'), then strip residual HTML tags). No PDF endpoint was found in any public code or search results — only Html and Text variants. Example live ids: 743842, 724005, 706392.

Official Collection of Decisions (Sbírka rozhodnutí NSS) — only selected/published decisions with právní věta, NOT the full corpus, but trivially scrapable with no CSRF/session (verbatim from worldwidelaw/legal-sources sources/CZ/NSS/bootstrap.py and jakub-kucera/llm-rag-dip SACD/scrape_nss.py): archive list GET /cz/archiv (links match href="/cz/{YYYY}-{issue}"); year listing GET /cz/{year}; issue page GET /cz/{year}-{issue} with decision links matching href="(/cz/[^"]+\.p\d+\.html)"; decision page GET /cz/{slug}.p{id}.html — title in <title> (suffix ' | Sbírka rozhodnutí Nejvyššího správního soudu'), právní věta in <div class="pravni-veta-nadpis">, full text in <div class="jud">, citation number in <div class="num-tag-wrap">. There is also an HTML search at /cz/vyhledavani with ?_page=N pagination. Useful as a fallback/secondary source for canonical published decisions.

OLD interface (pre-2022, DEFUNCT — replaced by vyhledavac.nssoud.cz; www.nssoud.cz is now the court's new CMS site whose /vyhledavac page just links to the new portal). Historical endpoints as used by tompecina/legal (legal/szr/cron.py, legal/udn/cron.py): 'main0Col.aspx?cls=JudikaturaBasicSearch&pageSource=0', 'main0Col.aspx?cls=JudikaturaSimpleSearch&pageSource=1&menu=187', 'main2Col.aspx?cls=RozhodnutiList&menu=185', 'mainc.aspx?cls=InfoSoud&kau_id={id}' — classic ASP.NET WebForms with ViewState. Do not build on these; listed only to date the generations. The current interface in 2025/2026 is vyhledavac.nssoud.cz, and within it there are itself two generations: pre-2025 (top-level DatumOd/DatumDo form fields) and the 2025 redesign (nested vyhledavaciSekce[...] model described above) — code targeting the pre-2025 field names silently breaks.

findings.caveats: No public JSON API exists; worldwidelaw/legal-sources explicitly deprioritized this source as 'no public API (requires CSRF tokens/sessions)'. Search requires the antiforgery handshake: for a stateless serverless MCP call that means 2 round-trips (GET / then POST /Home/Index) per search, +1 per extra page, +2 per decision (detail + fulltext); document endpoints need no session at all. Sessions/tokens are valid ~20-30 min; stella caches one session for 10 min in module scope and reports that creating a fresh session per request triggers rate limiting after ~10-20 requests — on Vercel, cache the cookie+token+formFields in module/global scope of the warm lambda and invalidate on anomaly. Session expiry manifests as HTTP 200 with the blank search form (no 'Počet nalezených záznamů' line) — must be detected, not assumed to be zero results. /DokumentOriginal/Text/{id} responses are UTF-16 (garbage if decoded as UTF-8); /DokumentOriginal/Html/{id} returns a literal 'N/A' body for missing documents. Result HTML entity-escapes Czech characters (č as č etc.) and uses   inside case numbers; the currParams/currSort script literals contain \\u0022-style escapes that must be decoded before re-POSTing, otherwise MyResTRowsCont returns an empty body (which looks like end-of-results). Pagination is asymmetric: 40 rows inline, then 20 rows per MyResTRowsCont pageNum (pageNum=1 → rows 41-60). Search form field names for fulltext, spisová značka, soud, právní věta were NOT found verbatim in any public code (only the date fields and the condition model with TechnickyNazev 'datumvydanirozhodnuti', Id 19, are confirmed) — harvest the form at runtime or capture browser traffic once against the live site; likewise unverified: whether /Home/MyResTRowsCont works with zero cookies, what pageNum=0 returns there, the semantics of ?formular=N, and whether the antiforgery token is strictly validated. No PDF endpoint exists as far as public code shows. Coverage starts 2003-02-04; decisions are published with delay after their decision date; the portal mixes NSS and regional administrative-court decisions distinguishable only via ECLI on the detail page. Bot protection appears mild (no WAF/Cloudflare reported by any scraper; a normal User-Agent and modest rate suffice), but this environment could not probe the live host (gateway-blocked), so live verification of the exact form field names and cookie requirements remains to be done from Vercel. The interface is unversioned and changed incompatibly in 2025 — treat all selectors/field names as fragile and fail loud on missing 'Počet nalezených záznamů'.

findings.source: Nejvyšší soud ČR — rozhodnuti.nsoud.cz (decision database of the Czech Supreme Court)

access.auth: none (public; send a browser-like User-Agent; one scraper additionally does a warm-up GET to https://rozhodnuti.nsoud.cz/ to pick up a Domino session cookie and sends Referer: https://rozhodnuti.nsoud.cz/ — reportedly sometimes required for $$WebSearch1)
access.detail:
PRIMARY SEARCH — Domino full-text search view, GET, returns server-rendered HTML. URL template (verbatim from 3 working scrapers, 2025–2026): GET /Judikatura/judikatura_ns.nsf/$$WebSearch1?SearchView&Query=&SearchMax=1000&SearchOrder=4&Start=0&Count=20&pohled=1 (path segment case-insensitive: both /Judikatura/ and /judikatura/ are used; Start=0 and Start=1 both seen) Query language (Domino FT syntax; AND / OR / parentheses / "quoted phrases" / * wildcard). Field names seen VERBATIM in working queries: - [datum_predani_na_web]>=24.02.2025 — date handed to the web; both DD.MM.YYYY and DD/MM/YYYY literals seen working; range: [datum_predani_na_web]>=D AND [datum_predani_na_web]<=D - [spzn1] = 23 — senate number of the spisová značka - [spzn2]=cdo — registry code (cdo, icdo, tdo, ncsr…, case-insensitive) - [ARozhodnutiRT]=(("o. z." OR "občansk* zákon*" OR "89/2012")) — FULL-TEXT of the decision body - [kolegium]=1 / [obko]=1 — civil & commercial college flags - [kategorie_rozhodnuti1]=A — decision category A/B/C… Other URL params: SearchMax=1000 (must be large; SearchMax=1 provokes HTTP 500), SearchOrder=4 (view order — used by all scrapers; other values unverified), Count = rows per page (UI offers 20/40/60 but Count=200 and Count=900 are honored), Start = row offset, pohled=1 (meaning unverified, always sent). HARD RESULT WINDOW: only the first 900 documents of any query are addressable regardless of SearchMax (measured by the stella production adapter: SearchMax 300/1000/2000/5000 all cap at 900; Start past the window returns an empty table, not later rows). When truncated, the page prints the true count as "(Podmínce vyhovuje: 50454 )". Normal count banner: "Výsledky 1 - 23 z 23 zobrazovaných dokumentů." Empty result marker: "Nebyly nalezeny žádné výsledky vyhledávání". Pagination inside the window: increment Start, or follow the "Další" link. RESULT ROW PARSING (verbatim regex from production code): /[0-9A-Fa-f]{32})\?openDocument"[^>]*>(?[\s\S]*?)<\/a>/g Each row: a.odk anchor → 32-hex Domino UNID + spisová značka (one decision may list several dockets separated by
inside ONE anchor); td.icons a[href] → PDF attachment link (href contains ".pdf?OpenElement"); input[name='ids'] value = UNID; td.category = category. Raw Domino HTML has no ; rows live under table#tabl. DECISION DETAIL (full text + metadata): GET /Judikatura/judikatura_ns.nsf/WebSearch/{UNID}?openDocument (canonical permalink; optional &Highlight=0) Metadata table: table#tabl rows with td.left-part (label) / td.right-part (value); labels: "Soud", "Datum rozhodnutí", "Spisová značka", "ECLI", "Typ rozhodnutí", "Heslo", "Dotčené předpisy", "Kategorie rozhodnutí", "Právní věta", "Zveřejněno na webu". Dates on this page in Czech format "20. 5. 2026". (An alternative parser matches legacy -tag markup for the same labels — both patterns are in active use in 2026.) Decision body sits in runs; body starts at "Nejvyšší soud rozhodl/…" and ends before "Citace rozhodnutí". PRINT VERSION (cleanest HTML for full-text extraction): GET /Judikatura/judikatura_ns.nsf/WebPrint/{UNID}?openDocument Metadata table id #box-table-a (same labels; Heslo and Dotčené předpisy values
-separated; a nested table appears when a related ústavní stížnost exists). NOTE: dates on WebPrint render in US format MM/DD/YYYY (two independent parsers confirm). ECLI format: ECLI:CZ:NS:2026:27.CDO.1525.2025.1.

DOMINO ReadViewEntries JSON — the only true JSON endpoint; used by a production ingestion pipeline (stella) live in 2026 for enumeration (NOT search — the view is sorted by UNID, not by date):

GET /Judikatura/judikatura_ns.nsf/WebSearch?ReadViewEntries&Count=40&Start=1&OutputFormat=JSON

Response shape (verbatim from typed client code):
{ "@toplevelentries": "164389", "viewentry": [ { "@position": "1", "@unid": "<32-hex>", "entrydata": [ { "@name": "znacka", "text": { "0": "27 Cdo 1525/2025" } }, … ] } ] }
viewentry is an object (not array) when Count=1. Known entrydata field: "znacka" (spisová značka); other column names unverified. @toplevelentries = total documents in DB (~164,000 as of spring 2026; DB grows ~40k/decade). Start is a 1-based position cursor; positions SHIFT when documents are inserted, so this endpoint is unsuitable for stable pagination near the tip — pair it with $$WebSearch1 date-range queries for recency (the entire pre-2010 archive shares one stamped publication date, 2009-12-31, with 50,454 docs — that day is not listable within the 900-doc window).
Given a UNID from here, fetch full text via WebSearch/{UNID}?openDocument or WebPrint/{UNID}?openDocument as above.

SEARCH-FORM POST (the human form's submit target; seen in one pilot connector, less battle-tested than $$WebSearch1):
POST /judikatura/judikatura_ns.nsf/searchRozhodnuti2?createdocument
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Body fields seen verbatim: spzn1=29, spzn2=ICdo, dateod=YYYY-MM-DD, datedo=YYYY-MM-DD, pocet_vysledku=20|40|60 (only these three accepted), pass1=1, kolegium=1.
Response: same result-list HTML as $$WebSearch1 (parse a.odk anchors as above). The public form also offers running number/year of the sp. zn., ECLI, heslo, dotčené předpisy and full-text inputs per the court's help page, but those form field names could NOT be confirmed from code — for a serverless MCP server prefer building $$WebSearch1 GET queries directly. To find a decision by complete spisová značka "23 Cdo 1234/2025", the proven pattern is Query=[spzn1]=23 AND [spzn2]=cdo plus a full-text term for "1234/2025" (or plain FT phrase "23 Cdo 1234/2025"); a dedicated [spzn3]/[spzn4]/[ecli] query field likely exists but was not seen verbatim anywhere.

findings.caveats: CURRENT INTERFACE (2025/2026): rozhodnuti.nsoud.cz IS the current interface, but it is NOT a modern SPA — it is the same IBM Lotus Notes/Domino application (judikatura_ns.nsf) as the old nsoud.cz/Judikatura/judikatura_ns.nsf, split off to a dedicated subdomain when the court launched its new CMS-based www.nsoud.cz; the court's own announcement says the search kept "the same layout of search options as before". All endpoints above are Domino classic-web endpoints; three independent scrapers (incl. one production pipeline with a 2026-05 sync cursor and one RSS feed with 2026 dates in code) use them today. Whether old deep links on www.nsoud.cz still redirect could not be verified from this environment (direct HTTP to Czech court domains blocked here, archive.org blocked too). Server quirks: hard 900-document window per search query (slice by [datum_predani_na_web] ranges to enumerate; verify with the "Podmínce vyhovuje" counter and refuse truncated pages); SearchMax=1 → HTTP 500; raw HTML lacks <tbody> and uses 1990s <font> markup; hrefs contain unencoded spaces (must be %-encoded before re-fetch); date formats are inconsistent (Czech "d. m. yyyy" on WebSearch detail, US MM/DD/YYYY on WebPrint, DD.MM.YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY literals in queries); one decision can carry several spisové značky in one result anchor; UNID (32-hex) is the only stable document identity — spisová značka is NOT unique. Politeness: production adapter paces ≥200 ms between requests and fetches ~40 detail pages/40 s; the court states data are free to use with source attribution. No WAF/bot-protection reported by any scraper (GitHub-Actions and server IPs work, good sign for Vercel egress); one scraper defensively warms up a session cookie and sends browser UA + Referer. No JSON search API exists — search responses must be HTML-parsed; only ReadViewEntries returns JSON. Encoding is UTF-8. For the pre-2010 archive, date-slicing fails (whole archive stamped 2009-12-31). Stability: interface unchanged for many years but is legacy tech with occasional 500s — build retries. Sister sites (different tech, out of scope): sbirka.nsoud.cz (new Collection site) and the court's ařední deska on www.nsoud.cz.

findings.source: NALUS — Ústavní soud (Czech Constitutional Court) decisions database, https://nalus.usoud.cz (classic ASP.NET WebForms, still the current and only interface as of 2025/2026; fixtures captured live 2026-08-01 confirm the same Search.aspx/Results.aspx/GetText.aspx surface)

access.detail: STATELESS single-document retrieval (works per-request with plain fetch, no cookies — confirmed independently by 3 scrapers and by Google-indexed URLs). GET /Search/GetText.aspx?sz={sz} where sz = '{registry}-{number}-{yy}_{counter}': registry is 1|2|3|4 (senates I.–IV. ÚS), 'Pl' (plenum), or 'St' (stanoviska, from Pl.ÚS-st); yy = 2-digit year; counter = document ordinal within the docket (a docket can publish several decisions). Examples seen verbatim: sz=1-709-05, sz=Pl-24-10_1, sz=1-517-10_2, sz=St-{case}-{yy}_{n}, sz=1-1169-26_1. Mapping from ECLI (janpetrov/caselaw): ECLI:CZ:US:{year}:{senate}.US.{num}.{yy}.{ord} -> sz={senate}-{num}-{yy}_{ord} (Pl.US -> 'Pl', Pl.US-st -> 'St'). URLs without the _counter suffix are also indexed (sz=4-475-01) but the canonical permalink the site emits includes ':443' and the counter. Response page structure (verbatim ids, from captured fixtures + working parsers): <span id="lblRegistrySign"> 'I.ÚS 1169/26 ze dne 7. 7. 2026', lblParallelQuotation, lblPopularName, lblCZHeader, lblDecisionForm, lblUS, lblDecisionFormNote; hidden inputs: registrySignHidden (value includes '#1' ECLI counter, e.g. 'I.ÚS 1169/26 #1 ze dne 7. 7. 2026'), paralellQuotationHidden (court's own misspelling), popularNameHidden, docIdHidden (NALUS internal record id — cross-checkable against ResultDetail id), docContentHidden (court's plain text with RTF markers \par, \b/\b0 — best source for clean fulltext); the same body rendered as HTML sits in <td class="DocContent"><table><tr><td>…. Error/empty detection: page contains 'nenalezeno' or is very short (<~6000 bytes). Companion endpoint, also stateless: GET /Search/GetAbstract.aspx?sz={sz} → abstract in table.abstractContent td, právní věta in table.legalSentenceContent td. Also exists: GET /Search/ResultDetail.aspx?id={internalId}&pos=..&cnt=..&typ=result (record metadata by internal numeric id; used as identity URL by scrapers, statelessness NOT verified — pos/cnt look session-relative).

SEARCH is a 3-request WebForms dance that DOES require the ASP.NET session cookie between steps, but completes fine inside one serverless invocation with manual cookie handling (two working Node fetch implementations exist: stella/stella cz-us.ts and Gamnog/Paperclip---X1 nalus.js). Flow: (1) GET Search.aspx (capture Set-Cookie; extract hidden __VIEWSTATE, __VIEWSTATEGENERATOR, __EVENTVALIDATION — POST fails without __EVENTVALIDATION). (2) POST Search.aspx, Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded, headers Cookie + Referer: Search.aspx, body: __EVENTTARGET='', __EVENTARGUMENT='', __VIEWSTATE, __VIEWSTATEGENERATOR, __EVENTVALIDATION, ctl00$MainContent$but_search='Vyhledat', plus filters. Decision-type checkboxes ('on'): ctl00$MainContent$nalezy, $usneseni, $stanoviska_plena, $jen_publikovana (only SbNU-published). Full-text: ctl00$MainContent$text plus scope checkboxes $pravni_veta, $abstrakt, $naveti, $vyrok, $oduvodneni, $argumentace_ustavniho_soudu, $odlisne_stanovisko. Identifiers: ctl00$MainContent$citace (Citace: sp. zn. / Sb. / SbNU, e.g. 'Pl. ÚS 24/10' — the way to search by spisová značka), ctl00$MainContent$ecli (ECLI), $popularni_nazev. Dates (format D.M.YYYY): ctl00$MainContent$decidedFrom/$decidedTo (datum rozhodnutí), $publicationFrom/$publicationTo (vyhlášení), $submissionFrom/$submissionTo (podání), $availableFrom/$availableTo (datum zpřístupnění; set ctl00$MainContent$dle_data_zpristupneni='on' when filtering by availability), $zpristupneno_pred (1–60, 'only additions in last N days' — good for incremental sync). People/parties: ctl00$MainContent$soudce_zpravodaj, $soudce_stanovisko, $slozeni_organu, $navrhovatel, $affected_organ_type, $affected_organ_spec, $actkind/$actkindnumber_txt/$actkindname_txt/$actkindclause_txt (napadený akt), $vyrok_multi, $vztah_k_predpisum, $predmet_rizeni, $klicove_slovo (věcný rejstřík), $poznamka (some of these are 'číselník' popup-picker values — pass exact catalogue strings). Presentation: ctl00$MainContent$razeni (sort: 2=decision date desc [default], 3=asc, 5=relevance, 6/7=sp. zn. desc/asc, 8/9=announcement date, 20=availability date desc), ctl00$MainContent$resultsPageSize (10|20|40|80 — 80 is honored), $resultsFontSize (e.g. '10'). RESPONSE: HTTP 302 Location: /Search/Results.aspx on hits (search context is stored SERVER-SIDE in the session); HTTP 200 re-render on zero hits with span #ctl00_MainContent_lbError = 'Pro zadaná kritéria nebyly nalezeny žádné záznamy.' and #ctl00_bResults disabled. Use fetch redirect:'manual' so the POST's Set-Cookie isn't lost. (3) GET /Search/Results.aspx (page 0) or /Search/Results.aspx?page={N} (0-indexed) with the accumulated Cookie header — pagination is pure GET with the session cookie, no further postbacks. Results page parsing (verbatim): count banner 'Výsledky {from} - {to} z celkem {total}' printed twice (above+below table); two header rows id=headerRow(First|Second) with td.resultDataHeader columns: Sp.zn. | Navrhovatel | Datum rozhodnutí | Vztah k předpisům | Forma rozhodnutí | Výrok | Předmět řízení | ECLI Soudce zpravodaj | Populární název | (Datum vyhlášení) Datum podání Datum zpřístupnění | Význam | Věcný rejstřík. Each hit = two rows (data row + actions row, second has valign="top"); data row cell[1] holds I.ÚS 1169/26 #1, the ECLI (ECLI:CZ:US:…), and the reporting judge stacked with
; the actions row emits the canonical permalink via onclick ShowLink("https://nalus.usoud.cz:443/Search/GetText.aspx?sz=…") and the citation string via ShowLink("…sp. zn.…", "Citace"). Extract sz with regex /GetText\.aspx\?sz=([^"&\s]+)/. Then fetch each document via stateless GetText.aspx (session not needed).

NO machine-readable alternative exists as of 2025/2026: no JSON API, no RSS, no open-data dump. Verified negatives (checked 2026 by the Paperclip connector authors, recorded in code comments): nalus.usoud.cz/robots.txt → 404, nalus.usoud.cz/opendata/ → 404; the only Ústavní soud dataset in the national open-data catalogue (data.gov.cz/NKOD) is its úřední deska (official notice board), not decisions. The Ministry of Justice open data + REST API at https://rozhodnuti.justice.cz/opendata/ covers ONLY ordinary courts (okresní/krajské/vrchní) — Ústavní soud is NOT included. No rozhodnuti.usoud.cz-style successor site exists; usoud.cz's 'Vyhledávání rozhodnutí ÚS' page just links to NALUS. ECLI-based retrieval: ÚS decisions carry ECLI and are searchable in the EU e-justice ECLI search engine (UI only, no public API) and by ECLI on NALUS itself via the ctl00$MainContent$ecli search field (there is no GetText.aspx?ecli= shortcut — sz must be derived, or better, read off search results). The court added an AI chatbot to usoud.cz/NALUS (first AI deployment on Czech court sites) and 'improved search' tweaks, but published no API for either. Salvia/Direct Case MCP servers independently index ÚS decisions ('us' index) and can serve as a fallback, but they are third-party mirrors, not the court's interface.

Advanced-search form fields, verbatim from a captured browser POST (HAR, 2026-08-27, all picker items selected): ctl00$MainContent$ + {text, ecli, citace, popularni_nazev, decidedFrom/To, publicationFrom/To (vyhlášení), submissionFrom/To (podání), availableFrom/To (zpřístupnění), soudce_zpravodaj, soudce_stanovisko, navrhovatel, affected_organ_type, affected_organ_spec, actkind, actkindnumber_txt, actkindname_txt, actkindclause_txt, vyrok_multi, jen_publikovana, nalezy/usneseni/stanoviska_plena, text zones pravni_veta/abstrakt/naveti/vyrok/oduvodneni/argumentace_ustavniho_soudu/odlisne_stanovisko (form defaults: naveti+vyrok+oduvodneni+odlisne_stanovisko checked), razeni (2=date desc, 3=date asc, 5=relevance 'význam', 6/7=sp. zn., 8/9=vyhlášení, 20=zpřístupnění desc), resultsPageSize}. Picker fields post comma+space-joined codebook TITLES (no ids); some výrok titles contain ', ' themselves ('procesní - náhrada nákladů zastoupení - § 83, 84') and one carries a double space ('procesní -  změna návrhu') — the codebooks are frozen verbatim in src/sources/nalus.ts (NALUS_OUTCOMES/PETITIONERS/ORGAN_TYPES/ACT_KINDS). NOT wired (popup codebooks not captured): typ_rizeni, slozeni_organu, vztah_k_predpisum (statute citator - needs a HAR of its picker popup + a search using it), predmet_rizeni, klicove_slovo (věcný rejstřík), poznamka, dle_data_zpristupneni+zpristupneno_pred, info.

findings.caveats: Statefulness: GetText.aspx and GetAbstract.aspx are fully stateless (per-request friendly); the search flow needs the ASP.NET session cookie only across its own 3 requests (GET form → POST → GET Results.aspx[?page=N]) — all within one serverless invocation; there is no CSRF beyond __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION, which must be scraped fresh each time (they are per-GET tokens; do not cache). Results.aspx?page=N is only meaningful while the session that POSTed the search is alive — a paginating MCP tool must either re-POST the search per page request or fetch all needed pages in one invocation (resultsPageSize=80 minimizes round trips; page param is 0-indexed). Node fetch: use redirect:'manual' on the POST (default follow loses Set-Cookie context) and merge cookies from both the GET and the POST. Empty result sets return HTTP 200 (not 302) with 'Pro zadaná kritéria nebyly nalezeny žádné záznamy.' in #ctl00_MainContent_lbError. Encoding is UTF-8 with HTML numeric entities; permalinks the site emits contain ':443' (normalize). Never reconstruct sz from a docket number: historical identifiers use a different grammar, chamber numbering was not globally sequential, plenary dockets overlap chamber numbers, and one docket can publish several decisions (counter suffix _N; hidden registrySignHidden carries '#N') — enumerate via search instead. Several search fields (výrok, vztah k předpisům, předmět řízení, věcný rejstřík, navrhovatel/dotčený orgán types) are catalogue ('číselník') fields filled via popup dialogs (/dialogs/PopupCiselnikTree.aspx etc.) and expect exact catalogue strings — free text there may silently match nothing. No WAF/bot-protection reported by any scraper; still, it is a single ASP.NET box (~70k+ decisions since 1993) monitored by Hlídač státu for slowness — existing scrapers self-limit to ~1 req/s and it is occasionally slow. The 'datum zpřístupnění' index is a rolling recent window (good for incremental monitoring, not for total-corpus availability queries deep in history — use decidedFrom/To per year for backfills). Layout has been stable for years but is scrape-fragile; anchor parsing on the 'Výsledky X - Y z celkem Z' banner, tr.resultData0/1 rows, ResultDetail.aspx?id=, ShowLink GetText URLs, lbl* span ids and docContentHidden. Electronic texts are official but 'neautentická' (non-authentic) per the court's own notice. ResultDetail.aspx statelessness unverified. Could NOT be established: any query-string interface to Search.aspx (filters go only via POST body), any bulk export, and live verification from this environment (Czech domains blocked here) — but all endpoints/fields above are quoted verbatim from working code and from form/result HTML captured live on 2026-08-01.

findings.source: rozhodnuti.justice.cz — Ministry of Justice (ČR) database of decisions of obecné soudy (okresní, krajské, vrchní). Current and only generation of the site (SPA, pilot data from 2020-10-01, publication mandate for first-instance civil decisions from 1.7.2022). The documented public machine interface is the REST open-data API under /api/opendata + /api/finaldoc; there is no older public interface for these courts (pre-2021, lower-court decisions were simply not published; CSLAV/Infodata carries only aggregates).

access.detail:
OFFICIAL open-data REST API (OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec published by the ministry: github.com/MSPotevrenadata/soudnirozhonduti_api, file YAML_rozhodnuti.yaml, server url 'https://rozhodnuti.justice.cz/api'). All endpoints are GET, JSON, no auth, no key. Hierarchy strictly by DATE OF PUBLICATION (datumZverejneni):

1) GET /api/opendata -> array of years: [{"rok":2020,"pocet":797,"odkaz":"https://rozhodnuti.justice.cz/api/opendata/2020"}] (404 if none). Verified year counts (live probe 2026-07-25): 2020: 797, 2021: 150939, 2022: 181862, 2023: 85463, 2024: 61207, 2025: 71528, 2026 partial: 42230 — approx 594k total.
2) GET /api/opendata/{rok} -> months: [{"rok":2020,"mesic":10,"pocet":26,"odkaz":".../api/opendata/2020/10"}]
3) GET /api/opendata/{rok}/{mesic} -> days: [{"datum":"2020-10-20","pocet":4,"odkaz":".../api/opendata/2020/10/20"}]
4) GET /api/opendata/{rok}/{mesic}/{den}?page={n} -> paginated decision list, 100 items/page, page is 0-INDEXED (page 0 implicit when param omitted). Response object: {"items":[...], "totalPages":N, "pageNumber":N}. Item fields (verbatim): jednaciCislo (spisová značka, e.g. "14 C 263/2020-19"), soud (court name string, e.g. "Okresní soud v Mostě"), autor (judge), ecli (e.g. "ECLI:CZ:OSMO:2020:14.C.263.2020.2"), predmetRizeni, datumVydani (YYYY-MM-DD), datumZverejneni, klicovaSlova (string[]), zminenaUstanoveni (string[] like "§ 142 z. č. 99/1963 Sb."), odkaz (absolute URL to /api/finaldoc/{uuid}).

IMPORTANT LIMITATION for a live-search MCP server: this API has NO server-side filters at all — no full-text query, no court filter, no spisová-značka lookup, no statute filter, no date-range query other than the y/m/d path itself (independently confirmed by politicas research doc and by strale-io spike notes). Any 'search' over it means walking days and filtering client-side.

NKOD (data.gov.cz) dataset 00025429/1525174511 'Rozhodnutí okresních, krajských a vrchních soudů' lists exactly one distribution endpoint: https://rozhodnuti.justice.cz/api/opendata (no bulk ZIP/dump exists). License CC BY 4.0, publisher Ministerstvo spravedlnosti, 'continuously updated'.

Full text of one decision by UUID, GET, JSON, no auth. UUID comes from the listing item's 'odkaz' field (format .../api/finaldoc/1d6380c9-0364-498a-b494-d162a90121cb). Response shape (verbatim from stella/stella typed validators + Robojudge parser + live-verified sample): top-level { uuid, verdictText: string|null, justificationText: string|null, header: Paragraph[]|null, verdict: Paragraph[]|null, justification: Paragraph[]|null, information: Paragraph[]|null, styles: Style[]|null, metadata: { type: "JUDGEMENT"|"RESOLUTION"|"ORDER", solver: string | {titlesBefore, firstName, lastName, titlesAfter, function}, caseNumber, caseResultType: string|string[], caseSubject, regulations: array, flags: string[], affectedDocs } }. Paragraph = { texts: [{ text: string, anonStyle: "NONE"|"ANON" }], styleLocalId: number, tableCellInfo }. Style = { localId, alignment, hasSpaceBefore, hasSpaceAfter, bold, italic }. anonStyle=="ANON" marks redacted placeholders (e.g. "Jméno zainteresované osoby 0/0", "IČO zainteresované společnosti 0/0"). Simplest fulltext = verdictText + "\n\n" + justificationText; richer extraction joins texts[].text per paragraph. Typical doc ~20-60 KB JSON. Human-readable SPA detail page for linking users: https://rozhodnuti.justice.cz/rozhodnuti/?id={uuid} (same uuid).

NOT ESTABLISHED. The SPA's search page ('VYHLEDAT ROZHODNUTÍ...') offers full-text, soud, spisová značka, datum od/do, klíčová slova filters (with 'all words / any word / exact phrase' modes per site help), so an internal JSON search endpoint must exist — but NO GitHub client, scraper, or article uses it, and its path/POST-body format could not be verified from any external source. GitHub code search for the domain (45 total hits, all inspected) shows every consumer (Robojudge, SOUDAI, stella, worldwidelaw, aveekpatra RAG pipeline) uses only /api/opendata + /api/finaldoc. The only mention of a search path is a strale-io/strale spike note (2026-04-18) that itself had NOT yet resolved it: 'Probe https://rozhodnuti.justice.cz/api/search and variants. Inspect public UI ... frontend likely calls an internal JSON endpoint visible in network tab.' To pin it down you must open the SPA with browser DevTools (network tab, Fetch/XHR) from an unblocked network — this environment's egress proxy blocks the domain and archive.org, so I could not read the JS bundle. Do not build on /api/search until observed; alternatives for live search per request: (a) day-walk + client-side filter via opendata (only viable for narrow date ranges), (b) a third-party mirror/index (e.g. the Salvia MCP 'justice' index mirrors this corpus).

findings.caveats:
Rate limits and bot protection: NO auth, NO API key, NO WAF/JS challenge observed by any client — plain requests/httpx/node-fetch with a trivial User-Agent works (Robojudge uses default httpx; SOUDAI uses UA 'SOUDAI-scraper/1.0'; a July 2026 live probe got clean 200s on every endpoint). The server DOES return HTTP 429 when overloaded: stella/stella's production adapter notes '(t)he court server returns 429 when overloaded (handled with a 2s backoff)' and retries 429/5xx with exponential backoff+jitter (base 1s, max 30s); they sustain 15 concurrent finaldoc fetches with 50ms batch delays. Polite crawlers self-limit to ~1 req/s. No documented numeric quota anywhere.
Pagination quirks: day-listing pages are 0-indexed, 100 items/page; read totalPages from the first response; page 0 is implicit.
Data quirks: (1) days are backfilled AFTER first publication — stella re-walks a 14-day tip window because 'a day walked the hour it opened is not final'; (2) metadata field types drift WITHOUT notice (solver string->object, caseResultType string->string[], regulations string[]->object[]) — validate leniently; (3) feed starts 2020-10-01 (pilot); real volume from mid-2022 mandate; corpus is overwhelmingly first-instance civil (debt collection, divorce) + criminal bribery §331-334 only; krajské/vrchní decisions are a small share; (4) party names, IČOs and addresses are anonymized out (anonStyle ANON placeholders) — search-by-party is impossible by design; judge, court, jednaciCislo, ECLI, dates, keywords and cited provisions survive; (5) responses are clean UTF-8 JSON.
Biggest gap: there is NO verified server-side search (full-text / soud / sp. zn. / date-range) — the open-data API is date-walk only, and the SPA's internal search endpoint remains unverified (see access entry 3). License CC BY 4.0 (NKOD), commercial use OK.
Interface generations: only one public generation exists (current in 2025/2026); /msp/ section of the same portal holds Ministry decisions; the official human docs live at https://rozhodnuti.justice.cz/opendata/ and /ostrance/.
